hero.title: Busy running your business? Let us handle the technology.
hero.subheadline: We build and manage websites and software, guide product development, improve customer support systems, and automate repetitive work. Practical technology help, from your first idea to everyday operations.

pillars.title: Build. Manage. Automate. Grow.
pillars.subheadline: Four connected services to help you launch, keep things running, and improve how your business works.

problems.title: What needs to work better?
items: Your website needs building, updating, or regular care.
Customer inquiries get lost across inboxes and disconnected tools.
Manual follow-ups, scheduling, and reports take too much of your time.
Your product idea needs a clear plan and someone to coordinate delivery.

process.title: From the first conversation to ongoing care
process.subheadline: Understand the need → Agree the scope → Build or improve → Launch → Maintain and review. Start with a defined project, then choose ongoing support where it helps.

featured.title: ClinchDesk
featured.description: A multi-tenant customer support SaaS platform with ticket management, role-based access control, customer portals, SLA workflows, knowledge management, and AI-assisted support.

engagements.title: Start with a project. Continue with a partner.
engagements.subheadline: Choose a website or software build, a support-system setup, an automation project, or product leadership. Monthly care and management are available with an agreed scope.

differentiator.title: One partner across the technology lifecycle
differentiator.text: Efosa Ojomo connects business needs, product planning, and hands-on delivery. We can help build the system, document how it works, and agree a practical plan for maintaining and improving it. Your proposal sets out the work, responsibilities, and service capacity.

items.q: Can you build and maintain my business website?
items.a: Yes. Website delivery and ongoing care can be scoped together or separately. A care plan sets out the updates, monitoring, maintenance, and minor improvements included each month.

items.q: Do you work with both business owners and startup founders?
items.a: Yes. Business owners can start with websites, support systems, and workflow automation. Founders and product teams can engage for discovery, custom software, and fractional product leadership.

items.q: Will you answer all of my customer support inquiries?
items.a: The service focuses on support technology: ticketing, knowledge bases, chatbots, routing, and workflow management. Human support-agent staffing and round-the-clock coverage are not included.

items.q: Does a monthly plan include unlimited changes?
items.a: No. Each agreement defines covered work, capacity, service hours, response expectations, exclusions, and a process for additional requests. Larger features and new projects are quoted separately.
No. We start with the task and choose suitable tools. Straightforward integrations and rules may be a better fit; AI is used where it serves the agreed need.

finalCta.title: What could you take off your plate?
finalCta.text: Tell us what you need to build, manage, or simplify. We will work out a practical starting point and a clear scope.

audiences.title: Technology support for the way you work
